1.e4 e5 2.Bc4 Bc5 3.b4 Bxb4 4.f4 exf4 5..strategy: Builds the central pawn that the gambit was played for. It also opens the c1-bishop's diagonal, so the f4-pawn is attacked at once. Black is two pawns up, but White has space and the initiative.

Gives check to keep the extra pawns and win time, but the knight on f3 guards h4 and can simply take the bishop, so Black must recapture with the queen and bring it out early. That keeps the material at the cost of an exposed queen in an open position.
